correctness.rationale: For independent uniform-without-replacement habitat draws, exact absence multiplication yields F(x,y)=sum_s[1-C(A-a_s,x)/C(A,x)*C(B-b_s,y)/C(B,y)]. An independent exhaustive exact-rational enumeration of all species-abundance-pair multisets modulo habitat swap through N=6 reproduces the 2,4,14,28,69 census counts, three globally nonnested N=6 profiles, and the unique adjacent-gap profile with budget-2 optimum (x,y)=(2,0) and budget-3 optimum (0,3). For unbounded r>=2 and K>=r+2, the displayed loss D=(1-x/r)y(y-1)/(K(K-1))+x(r+1)y/(rK) is the expectation of within-B duplication plus cross-habitat repeated species; xy>=r for x>=1 makes D(x,r+1-x)>D(0,r+1). At budget r all-A is uniquely perfect: every competing split has positive repetition probability. For disjoint species sets each habitat marginal richness gain is decreasing, so sorted marginal increments produce nested optima. Finite enumeration does not prove the unrestricted r,K statement; the inequalities do.
